raw_comment:
1) I notice that droughts in general are a lot more prevalent across the country than I previously was aware of. I also assumed that arid states would be more prone to drought than others, but that appears to be incorrect.
2) I wonder why the desert states maintain more water than Montana, West Virginia, Wyoming, and the Dakotas. I am also curious about if there’s any correlation between landlocked states and drought. 
3) This relates to my community because environmental issues such as these have an impact on all Americans and we need to do something to stop it. 
4) Droughts Spring Up Across America
